meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone and called me?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale, and was Owen heard before you entered it? If you won't answer that, I'm going upstairs to the principal's office before my call.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
Okay. Show me the line, and show me the October 15 outline. I'm writing both down.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that you show me the line you say is not in Hamlet and the October 15 outline. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still in her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see the two documents for herself.
What moved her: naming a specific quoted line not found in the play and a dated outline whose argument the essay drops, because it was concrete, dated, tied to Owen's own work and something she could check.
What cost ground: opening by refusing to talk and declaring the zero stands with no basis given, because it confirmed her belief that the school decides first and explains later.
Try next time: when she first asked who entered the zero before calling her, own that in one sentence and then put the October 15 outline in front of her right away.
